focus: what is in effect under a profile — `profiles show` applies it, `config show` doesn't
query: Which output directory does a run with our ci profile use?
files: demo-project — robot.toml sets output-dir at the top and in the profile `ci`
expected_behavior: Runs `robotcode -p ci profiles show` or `robotcode -p ci --dry robot`, which apply the profile
Doesn't rely on `robotcode -p ci config show`, which ignores the profile
